# 4 bed terraced house for sale

> Daly Auctioneers are delighted to welcome to the market number 35 Eiscir Island, Eiscir Meadows, Tullamore, Co. Offaly. 35 Eiscir Island is a four bed end terrace house located within the sought-after Eiscir Meadows development in Tullamore.
